{{Short description|Player squads for the 1704 FLLA World Cup}}

These are the squads for the [[1704 FLLA World Cup]], held in [[Emara]] between 17 June and 4 July 1704. Each of the sixteen participating national associations registered a squad of eighteen players, the maximum permitted under the 1704 regulations.<ref name="squadreg">{{cite web|url=https://www.flla.org/heritage/world-cup/1704/squads|title=Registered squads for the 1704 FLLA World Cup|publisher=[[FLLA]]|date=12 June 1704}}</ref> Substitutions were not permitted during matches under the laws of the game then in force, so the players beyond the starting eleven served only as cover for injury or illness before each fixture. Squads are listed by their first-round group; the captain of each side is marked (c). Player ages and club affiliations were not systematically recorded by the [[FLLA]] for this edition.
